title: IELTS 7000 核心词 · 100 词句精选
note: Selection of high-frequency academic words for IELTS Band 6-7.5. Each entry carries one core sentence, collocations, synonyms and word family for 10x vocabulary expansion.

words.def: to give up something completely
words.example: Many students abandon their study plans once the first novelty wears off.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生在最初的新鲜感消退后就放弃了学习计划。

words.def: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing
words.example: The abstract concept became clearer once the teacher used a simple diagram.
words.exampleZh: 老师用一张简单的示意图后，这个抽象概念变得清晰了。

words.def: to collect or increase gradually over time
words.example: Small habits accumulate into remarkable results over a single academic year.
words.exampleZh: 微小的习惯在一个学年里会积累成惊人的成果。

words.def: to change in order to suit a new situation
words.example: International students must adapt to a new academic culture within weeks.
words.exampleZh: 国际学生必须在几周内适应新的学术文化。

words.def: enough in quantity or good enough in quality
words.example: The library provides adequate space for group discussion and quiet reading.
words.exampleZh: 图书馆为小组讨论和安静阅读提供了充足的空间。

words.def: to publicly support an idea or policy
words.example: Many scientists advocate stricter limits on single-use plastic.
words.exampleZh: 许多科学家主张对一次性塑料实施更严格的限制。

words.def: to give money, time or resources for a purpose
words.example: The council will allocate more funds to public transport next year.
words.exampleZh: 市议会明年将向公共交通拨出更多资金。

words.def: having more than one possible meaning
words.example: The instructions were so ambiguous that half the class chose the wrong option.
words.exampleZh: 题目说明太模糊，一半同学选错了选项。

words.def: to expect that something will happen
words.example: Organisers anticipate a record crowd at the open-air concert.
words.exampleZh: 主办方预计露天音乐会将迎来创纪录的观众人数。

words.def: easy to see or understand
words.example: It soon became apparent that the team had underestimated its rival.
words.exampleZh: 很快就明显看出，这支队伍低估了对手。

words.def: to judge the quality or importance of something
words.example: Teachers assess students through both essays and short oral presentations.
words.exampleZh: 老师通过论文和简短口头展示来评估学生。

words.def: to think something is true without proof
words.example: Many readers assume that a headline is always supported by solid evidence.
words.exampleZh: 许多读者假定标题总是有确凿证据支撑的。

words.def: to say that something is caused by a particular thing
words.example: Researchers attribute the sudden rise in sales to one viral video.
words.exampleZh: 研究人员把销量的突然上升归因于一个爆款视频。

words.def: real, genuine and not a copy
words.example: The museum displays authentic instruments used by nineteenth-century composers.
words.exampleZh: 博物馆展出十九世纪作曲家使用过的真品乐器。

words.def: an unfair preference for or against something
words.example: The survey was criticised for a clear bias towards younger viewers.
words.exampleZh: 这项调查因明显偏向年轻观众而受到批评。

words.def: to increase or improve something
words.example: A short walk before class can boost concentration for the whole morning.
words.exampleZh: 课前短暂散步能提升整个上午的专注力。

words.def: having the ability or qualities needed to do something
words.example: The new telescope is capable of capturing images from distant galaxies.
words.exampleZh: 这台新望远镜能够拍摄遥远星系的图像。

words.def: to stop happening or existing
words.example: The factory will cease production unless demand recovers this winter.
words.exampleZh: 除非今年冬天需求回升，否则这家工厂将停止生产。

words.def: logical and well organised
words.example: A good essay presents a coherent argument from start to finish.
words.exampleZh: 一篇好文章从头到尾呈现连贯的论证。

words.def: to happen at the same time or agree exactly
words.example: The festival was timed to coincide with the start of the summer holidays.
words.exampleZh: 音乐节被安排在暑假开始的同时举行。

words.def: to fall down or fail suddenly
words.example: Engineers fear the old bridge could collapse under the weight of traffic.
words.exampleZh: 工程师担心这座老桥可能在车流重压下坍塌。

words.def: to give something to make up for a loss
words.example: The airline offered vouchers to compensate passengers for the long delay.
words.exampleZh: 航空公司提供代金券，以补偿乘客长时间的延误。

words.def: having enough skill or knowledge to do something well
words.example: A competent translator captures tone as well as literal meaning.
words.exampleZh: 称职的译者既能传达字面意思，也能传达语气。

words.def: including everything that is necessary
words.example: The report offers a comprehensive review of climate policy since 2015.
words.exampleZh: 这份报告对2015年以来的气候政策做了全面回顾。

words.def: to give all your attention to something
words.example: It is hard to concentrate when your phone keeps lighting up.
words.exampleZh: 手机不停亮起时很难集中注意力。

words.def: to decide something after considering the facts
words.example: The authors conclude that early intervention saves money in the long run.
words.exampleZh: 作者们得出结论：早期干预从长远看能节省开支。

words.def: to organise and carry out an activity
words.example: The team will conduct interviews with fifty local residents.
words.exampleZh: 团队将对五十位当地居民进行访谈。

words.def: to show that something is true
words.example: New evidence confirmed what historians had long suspected.
words.exampleZh: 新证据证实了历史学家长期以来的猜测。

words.def: a serious disagreement or difference
words.example: The conflict between commercial and conservation interests is hard to resolve.
words.exampleZh: 商业利益与保护利益之间的冲突很难化解。

words.def: a result of an action or situation
words.example: Cutting the budget had an unexpected consequence for rural schools.
words.exampleZh: 削减预算给乡村学校带来了意想不到的后果。

words.def: large in amount or degree
words.example: The project required a considerable amount of time and public funding.
words.exampleZh: 这个项目需要相当多的时间和公共资金。

words.def: always the same, or in agreement with something
words.example: Her results were consistent across three separate experiments.
words.exampleZh: 她的结果在三次独立实验中保持一致。

words.def: to be or form a particular thing
words.example: Tourists now constitute the largest group of visitors to the island.
words.exampleZh: 游客现在构成了该岛最大的访客群体。

words.def: belonging to the present time
words.example: Contemporary dance often blends classical technique with street styles.
words.exampleZh: 当代舞常常把古典技巧与街头风格融合在一起。

words.def: the situation in which something happens
words.example: A single line can change meaning depending on its context.
words.exampleZh: 仅仅一行文字，含义也可能随语境而变。

words.def: to compare things to show their differences
words.example: The essay contrasts city life with the quiet of the countryside.
words.exampleZh: 这篇文章把城市生活与乡村的宁静做了对比。

words.def: to give something or help to cause a result
words.example: Volunteers contribute thousands of hours to local conservation projects.
words.exampleZh: 志愿者为当地保护项目贡献了数千小时。

words.def: causing a lot of public disagreement
words.example: The decision to raise ticket prices proved highly controversial.
words.exampleZh: 提高票价的决定引起了很大争议。

words.def: to change something into a different form
words.example: The warehouse was converted into a studio for young artists.
words.exampleZh: 这个仓库被改造成了年轻艺术家的工作室。

words.def: to make someone believe or agree
words.example: It took a week to convince the committee to fund the project.
words.exampleZh: 花了一周时间才说服委员会为项目出资。

words.def: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
words.example: Small shops are struggling to cope with rising rents.
words.exampleZh: 小商铺正艰难应对不断上涨的租金。

words.def: extremely important
words.example: Sleep plays a crucial role in memory and emotional health.
words.exampleZh: 睡眠对记忆和情绪健康起着关键作用。

words.def: to develop a quality or grow plants
words.example: Schools should cultivate curiosity rather than simply reward correct answers.
words.exampleZh: 学校应当培养好奇心，而不只是奖励正确答案。

words.def: to become smaller or weaker
words.example: Sales of printed newspapers continue to decline year after year.
words.exampleZh: 纸质报纸的销量逐年持续下降。

words.def: to give time and effort to something
words.example: She dedicated three years to studying the migration of seabirds.
words.exampleZh: 她把三年时间投入到研究海鸟迁徙上。

words.def: to show clearly that something is true
words.example: The experiment demonstrates how quickly heat escapes through thin glass.
words.exampleZh: 这个实验展示了热量穿过薄玻璃散失的速度有多快。

words.def: to get something from a source
words.example: Many English words derive from Latin roots.
words.exampleZh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁词根。

words.def: to become worse
words.example: Air quality can deteriorate rapidly when winds drop.
words.exampleZh: 风速减弱时，空气质量会迅速恶化。

words.def: to become or make less
words.example: The impact of the advert diminishes after the first few weeks.
words.exampleZh: 广告的影响在最初几周后就减弱了。

words.def: controlled behaviour or a field of study
words.example: Learning a language requires discipline more than talent.
words.exampleZh: 学一门语言需要的更多是自律而非天赋。

words.def: clearly different or noticeable
words.example: The two species have distinct feeding habits.
words.exampleZh: 这两个物种有着截然不同的觅食习性。

words.def: including many different types
words.example: The city's food scene is as diverse as its population.
words.exampleZh: 这座城市的饮食风貌和它的人口一样多元。

words.def: to be the strongest or most important
words.example: Two companies dominate the global market for electric cars.
words.exampleZh: 两家公司主导着全球电动汽车市场。

words.def: full of energy and change
words.example: The city has a dynamic music scene that changes every month.
words.exampleZh: 这座城市有着每月都在变化的活力音乐场景。

words.def: working well without wasting time or energy
words.example: A well-designed timetable makes revision far more efficient.
words.exampleZh: 设计良好的时间表能让复习高效得多。

words.def: to explain something in more detail
words.example: Could you elaborate on how the data was collected?
words.exampleZh: 你能详细说明一下数据是如何收集的吗？

words.def: to remove something completely
words.example: The new filter can eliminate almost all microplastics from tap water.
words.exampleZh: 这款新过滤器几乎能去除自来水中的所有微塑料。

words.def: to appear or become known
words.example: A clear pattern began to emerge after the third round of tests.
words.exampleZh: 第三轮测试后，一个清晰的模式开始显现。

words.def: to give special importance to something
words.example: The coach emphasized the importance of rest as much as training.
words.exampleZh: 教练强调休息和训练同样重要。

words.def: to improve the quality or value of something
words.example: Good lighting can enhance the mood of a small room.
words.exampleZh: 良好的灯光能提升小房间的氛围。

words.def: very large in size or amount
words.example: The festival had an enormous impact on the local economy.
words.exampleZh: 音乐节对当地经济产生了巨大影响。

words.def: to make certain that something happens
words.example: Check the equipment twice to ensure nothing fails on stage.
words.exampleZh: 设备要检查两遍，确保舞台上不出任何故障。

words.def: completely necessary
words.example: Clean water is essential for public health.
words.exampleZh: 清洁的水对公共健康至关重要。

words.def: to start something that will last
words.example: The university established a research centre for artificial intelligence.
words.exampleZh: 这所大学建立了一个人工智能研究中心。

words.def: to judge something carefully
words.example: Officials will evaluate the scheme after its first year.
words.exampleZh: 官员们将在计划实施一年后对其进行评估。

words.def: easy to see or understand
words.example: It was evident from the audience's silence that the joke had failed.
words.exampleZh: 从观众的沉默可以明显看出，那个笑话没有奏效。

words.def: to develop gradually over time
words.example: Languages evolve faster than dictionaries can record.
words.exampleZh: 语言演变的速度快过词典的记录速度。

words.def: to be greater than a number or limit
words.example: Demand for the tickets far exceeded the venue's capacity.
words.exampleZh: 门票需求远远超过了场馆容量。

words.def: to not include something
words.example: The price excludes breakfast and airport transfers.
words.exampleZh: 该价格不含早餐和机场接送。

words.def: to use something for profit, sometimes unfairly
words.example: Some apps exploit users' attention to sell more advertising.
words.exampleZh: 一些应用利用用户的注意力来卖更多广告。

words.def: to make an action easier
words.example: A shared online folder can facilitate group work across time zones.
words.exampleZh: 共享的在线文件夹能便利跨时区的小组合作。

words.def: possible to do successfully
words.example: The plan is technically feasible but far too expensive.
words.exampleZh: 这个方案技术上可行，但成本太高。

words.def: to change often in level or amount
words.example: Fruit prices fluctuate with the seasons.
words.exampleZh: 水果价格随季节波动。

words.def: forming the basis of something
words.example: Trust is fundamental to any long-term partnership.
words.exampleZh: 信任是任何长期伙伴关系的基础。

words.def: to produce or create something
words.example: Wind farms generate electricity without burning fuel.
words.exampleZh: 风力发电场无需燃烧燃料就能发电。

words.def: real and sincere
words.example: Her surprise at the award seemed completely genuine.
words.exampleZh: 她对获奖的惊讶看起来完全发自内心。

words.def: to draw attention to something
words.example: The report highlights the gap between rich and poor schools.
words.exampleZh: 报告突出了富裕学校与贫困学校之间的差距。

words.def: an idea that is tested by research
words.example: The hypothesis was tested on two hundred volunteers.
words.exampleZh: 这一假设在两百名志愿者身上得到了检验。

words.def: exactly the same
words.example: The twins wore identical jackets to the concert.
words.exampleZh: 这对双胞胎穿着完全相同的外套去听音乐会。

words.def: to explain or show with examples
words.example: A simple chart can illustrate the trend more clearly than a paragraph.
words.exampleZh: 一张简单的图表比一段文字更能清楚地说明趋势。

words.def: a strong effect on someone or something
words.example: Social media has a profound impact on how teenagers see themselves.
words.exampleZh: 社交媒体对青少年如何看待自己有着深远影响。

words.def: to put a plan or system into action
words.example: The school will implement the new timetable in September.
words.exampleZh: 学校将在九月实施新的时间表。

words.def: to suggest something without saying it directly
words.example: Advertisements often imply that the product will make you more confident.
words.exampleZh: 广告常常暗示该产品会让你更自信。

words.def: to force a rule, tax or opinion on someone
words.example: The city imposed a tax on sugary drinks.
words.exampleZh: 这座城市对含糖饮料征税。

words.def: something that encourages an action
words.example: Tax breaks give companies an incentive to hire young workers.
words.exampleZh: 税收减免激励公司雇用年轻员工。

words.def: to show that something is true
words.example: Early results indicate that the treatment is working.
words.exampleZh: 早期结果表明该治疗正在起作用。

words.def: certain to happen
words.example: Some degree of change is inevitable in any growing city.
words.exampleZh: 在任何发展中的城市，一定程度的变化都不可避免。

words.def: to work out a conclusion from evidence
words.example: From the tone of the letter, we can infer that she was disappointed.
words.exampleZh: 从信的语气可以推断她感到失望。

words.def: to prevent something from developing
words.example: Fear of failure can inhibit creativity in young children.
words.exampleZh: 对失败的恐惧会抑制幼儿的创造力。

words.def: to start something new
words.example: The council initiated a programme to restore the old harbour.
words.exampleZh: 市议会发起了一项修复老港口的计划。

words.def: to introduce new ideas or methods
words.example: Small firms must innovate constantly to survive.
words.exampleZh: 小公司必须不断创新才能生存。

words.def: a clear understanding of something
words.example: The documentary offers a rare insight into life behind the stage.
words.exampleZh: 这部纪录片让人难得地窥见舞台背后的生活。

words.def: to combine parts into a whole
words.example: The new system integrates payments, bookings and customer records.
words.exampleZh: 新系统整合了支付、预订和客户记录。

words.def: very strong or extreme
words.example: The final was intense, with neither side willing to slow down.
words.exampleZh: 决赛非常激烈，双方都不愿放慢节奏。

words.def: to explain or understand the meaning of something
words.example: Different readers interpret the ending of the novel in opposite ways.
words.exampleZh: 不同的读者对小说结局有着相反的理解。

words.def: to become involved to change a situation
words.example: The teacher had to intervene before the argument turned into a fight.
words.exampleZh: 老师不得不在争吵变成打斗之前介入。

words.def: to give a good reason for something
words.example: The company struggled to justify the sudden price increase.
words.exampleZh: 公司难以解释这次突然涨价。

words.def: to keep something at the same level, or to claim
words.example: It is difficult to maintain a daily reading habit during exams.
words.exampleZh: 考试期间很难保持每天阅读的习惯。

words.def: to control something or someone skilfully, often unfairly
words.example: Some games manipulate players into spending money without noticing.
words.exampleZh: 有些游戏会在玩家不知不觉中诱导他们花钱。

words.def: to make something as large as possible
words.example: Farmers use every metre of land to maximise their harvest.
words.exampleZh: 农民利用每一米土地来使收成最大化。
